artworks.title: The Death of Socrates
artworks.description: Socrates reaches for the cup of hemlock while continuing to lecture his grieving followers — Neoclassicism's model of philosophical composure in the face of death.

source.collection: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York

artworks.title: Wheat Field with Cypresses
artworks.description: Painted from the asylum grounds at Saint-Rémy, its churning sky and flame-like cypress trees are among van Gogh's most turbulent late landscapes.

source.collection: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York
